title: A2A 1.0 callable interfaces come from supportedInterfaces, not the Agent Card discovery URL
claim: For A2A 1.0, an Agent Card is discovery metadata. A client selects a supported AgentInterface and sends requests to the URL declared by that selected supportedInterfaces[] entry; the URL used to retrieve the Agent Card is not automatically the callable A2A endpoint.
scope: A2A protocol version 1.0 semantics as reviewed on 2026-09-05, and ARWP routing behavior for valid A2A Agent Cards. This claim concerns discovery versus callable interface routing, not authentication or successful task execution.
doesNotProve: that a declared A2A interface is currently reachable
that the caller is authorized to use the interface
that an Agent Card signature establishes provider reputation or trust
that every future A2A protocol version will preserve the same field structure

facts.name: preferredInterfaceRule
facts.value: first supported transport in supportedInterfaces preference order

evidence.description: A2A 1.0 specification section 8 defines Agent Card discovery, supportedInterfaces declaration, client protocol selection and use of the selected interface URL.
A2A v1.0 change notes state that the AgentCard url field moved into supportedInterfaces and that supportedInterfaces consolidates callable interface declarations.
ARWP adapter implementation validates A2A Agent Cards and normalizes their declared supported interfaces while retaining card provenance.
ARWP decision-quality policy explicitly distinguishes Agent Card metadata from callable supportedInterfaces entries.

notes: This claim corrects an earlier ARWP protocol-semantics defect where the fetched Agent Card document URL could be treated as the callable agent endpoint.
If A2A upstream semantics change, publish a superseding claim rather than rewriting this reviewed claim in place.
